name: Elena Vance
title: Shader Architect & Interaction Engineer
bio: Specializing in procedural GLSL shaders, WebGL performance tuning, and interactive typography. Elena previously engineered interactive museum installations across Europe before co-founding JAHVA.
philosophy: Shaders are not decorative filters; they are dynamic computational materials that bring physical weight to the digital plane.

individualProjects.title: ChromaRay GLSL
individualProjects.description: An open source procedural volumetric raymarcher rendering complex SDF fractals directly in WebGL2 at 60fps.

individualProjects.title: Topological Noise Playground
individualProjects.description: Interactive procedural terrain generator exploring Simplex vector displacement and dynamic normal mapping in React Three Fiber.

name: Marcus Thorne
title: Performance Lead & Distributed Systems Specialist
bio: Obsessed with frame-budget enforcement, zero layout shifts, and server-component performance. Marcus has spent 12 years building low-latency trading interfaces and modern distributed web platforms.
philosophy: A 100 millisecond delay is an architectural failure. Beauty is meaningless if the interface stutters under user interaction.

individualProjects.title: ZeroShift CLI
individualProjects.description: Automated headless Chromium tool for detecting layout shifts down to fractional sub-pixels during simulated mobile network throttling.

individualProjects.title: Edge KV Streamer
individualProjects.description: Minimalist high-throughput distributed memory cache client for Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge functions.

name: Siobhan Kelly
title: Interface Choreographer & Type System Designer
bio: Bridging Swiss typography with cinematic spatial UI. Siobhan trained in physical publication design before transitioning into digital motion systems and accessible design engineering.
philosophy: Good design is structural clarity; memorable design is calibrated friction and unexpected physical tactility.

individualProjects.title: Typographic Gravity Spec
individualProjects.description: Experimental kinetic typography system where font weight and letter spacing dynamically deform based on scroll momentum and device tilt.

individualProjects.title: Machined Token UI
individualProjects.description: Zero runtime CSS token generator creating physical double-bezel chamfers and inset specular highlights for web interfaces.

name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
title: Canvas Architect & Protocol Integrator
bio: Crafting resilient real-time web applications and high-fidelity 2D/3D visualizers. Tariq combines deep browser networking with tactile graphics and generative canvas drawing.
philosophy: Every interactive state must acknowledge the user like a finely tuned instrument, with zero latency and absolute predictability.

individualProjects.title: VectorForge Infinite Canvas
individualProjects.description: Infinite canvas rendering engine utilizing spatial QuadTrees and offscreen canvas workers for smooth pan and zoom with 50,000 vector primitives.

individualProjects.title: AudioMesh Synthesizer
individualProjects.description: Browser-based additive synthesizer mapping spatial 3D geometry to real-time harmonic FM frequency modulation via the Web Audio API.
